name: MXNB
oneLiner: MXNB is Juno/Bitso's MXN-pegged stablecoin backed 1:1 by peso reserves at regulated banks with quarterly attestations; now issued from El Salvador under CNAD.
collateral: Mexican peso (MXN) fiat reserves and cash-equivalent assets held across multiple regulated financial institutions; beginning April 8, 2026, MXNB is issued by Nvio Pagos El Salvador, S.A. de C.V., an authorised digital-asset issuer in El Salvador
pegMechanism: 1:1 MXN fiat-collateralized stablecoin; Juno/MXNB materials describe reserve parity, token burn/redemption through issuer rails, and quarterly third-party attestations confirming reserves exceed circulating supply

sources.label: BDO Mexico MXNB Q1 2026 valuation report

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Juno/Bitso documents MXNB issuance and redemption through issuer APIs and lists MXNB on Arbitrum as an issuer stablecoin rather than a wrapped bridge asset. No separate bridge protocol was verified, so the route is reviewed as issuer-native mint/redeem across supported chains.

reserves.name: MXN fiat reserves and cash-equivalents at Mexican financial institutions
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Nvio, Hey Banco, and MXNB issuer

sources.label: BDO Mexico MXNB Q1 2026 valuation report

reserveReview.rationale: MXNB's current transparency page reports 35.3 million MXN of reserves and 34.8 million MXNB in circulation as of July 1, 2026. Its published BDO Mexico report examined the March 31 Nvio and Hey Banco statements and reconciled 26.95 million MXN of bank reserves against 24.82 million MXNB across the five tracked chains. The report identifies bank deposits but does not publish an account-by-account split, so the 100% MXN fiat and cash-equivalent envelope remains one slice.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: MXNB issuer transparency balance disclosure and whitepaper reserve policy
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve class and March 31 counterparties are identified, but neither the report nor the current balance page publishes an account-by-account allocation or legal account structure.

sources.label: BDO Mexico MXNB Q1 2026 valuation report

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The March 31 BDO Mexico report names Nvio and Hey Banco from issuer-supplied statements, but explicitly says it did not confirm balances with those institutions. Reviewed sources do not establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, provider shares, or rehypothecation treatment.

mintAuthority.summary: MXNB is a FiatToken-fork proxy. On Ethereum and Arbitrum, masterMinter() = owner() = EOA 0xcf3783abaf4a11da1382f0c49748fa87a1b6b739. Proxy admin is also EOA 0x4d64a2ccfed1a162c8b1d7a3d8fffeccab3305ca. All three are issuer-controlled EOAs with no multisig.

controls.label: MXNB masterMinter / owner (Ethereum, Arbitrum — EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295171, masterMinter() = 0xcf3783abaf4a11da1382f0c49748fa87a1b6b739; owner() = same address. eth_getCode = 0x (EOA confirmed on both Ethereum and Arbitrum). At Arbitrum block 472412264, masterMinter() and owner() also return 0xcf3783abaf4a11da1382f0c49748fa87a1b6b739.

controls.label: MXNB proxy admin (Ethereum and Arbitrum — EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295171, custom proxy admin slot (0x10d6a5...) = 0x4d64a2ccfed1a162c8b1d7a3d8fffeccab3305ca; eth_getCode = 0x (EOA confirmed). Same address in Arbitrum block 472412264 proxy admin slot.

review.evidence: MXNB on Ethereum and Arbitrum is an upgradeable FiatToken-fork proxy. masterMinter() and owner() both resolve to EOA 0xcf3783...b739 on both chains. The proxy admin slot also resolves to an EOA 0x4d64a2...05ca. All confirmed via eth_call and eth_getCode at blocks 25295171 (ETH) and 472412264 (ARB). The same contract address 0xf197ffc... is used on all five listed chains.
